plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Media Arts and Sciences (Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance), BA, plan HIDCIAPBA, campus ASU00). Term-by-term sequence as published. Credit ranges transcribed at the lower bound per convention; 'X or Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the course code with choice=true. Gen-ed placeholders (no course code on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. The official major map lists the following course(s) in more than one term: Digital Media Course OR Media Arts and Sciences Studies Course, ENG 101 or ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 or ENG 108: First-Year Composition, Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT), Term hours subtotal:, Upper Division Digital Media Course OR Upper Division Media Arts and Sciences Studies Course, Upper Division Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance Concentration, Upper Division Media Arts and Sciences Studies Course; allow_repeated_courses is set per the genuine-repeat rule. CORRECTION 2026-10-06 (wave-33 coordinator): removed the 'Term hours subtotal:' metadata rows the wave-32 harvester had transcribed as pseudo-courses in every term; per-term declared_credits and plan total_credits recomputed as the true sum of the official map's listed courses. All other fields (codes, titles, credits, order, choice flags, repeats) unchanged from the official ASU major map transcription.
